name: Hijikata Toshizou
source:
Executive officer of the Shinsengumi.
Training school: Tennen Rishin-ryū (intermediate license)

"A wolf instinctually continues to fight in the face of adversities. To the very moment its spirit burns out."
translation:
新选组副长。
修行道场：天然理心流（中传）

“狼会在逆境中凭本能继续战斗，直到意志燃尽的那一刻。”
